items.title: Hold an Aurora business license
items.authority: City of Aurora Tax and Licensing Division
items.description: Any business operating in Aurora or with employees there needs a city business license, one per location. The license covers two years from issuance and establishes sales, use, occupational privilege and lodger's tax filing roles.

items.title: Hold Colorado Springs sales tax license
items.authority: City of Colorado Springs Sales Tax Office
items.description: Businesses selling or leasing at retail in the city need a city sales tax license (no fee since September 1, 2023). Licenses expire every odd year on December 31 and are renewed online only.
items.deadline: Expires December 31 of every odd year

items.title: Obtain Denver sales and use tax license
items.authority: Denver Department of Finance, Treasury Division
items.description: Denver is a home-rule city and administers its own sales and use tax separately from the state.

items.title: Withhold and remit Denver Occupational Privilege Tax (OPT)
items.authority: Denver Department of Finance, Treasury Division
items.description: Employers and employees pay a monthly occupational privilege tax for work performed in Denver.
